meaning: Reported numeric abrasive grade; no common grading standard was assumed. Mesh and slash/emery notations were not converted.
Explicit preparation operations. A + separated list records multiple operations, not an inferred chronology or complete history.
Named chemical/electrochemical treatment or cleaning liquid. Rinse water and abrasive carriers were not added to an active treatment mixture.
Chemical/electrochemical preparation duration in hours, separate from heat treatment, air exposure and test-bath equilibration. Air-only timing with no separate treatment evidence remained missing.
Time in the test solution at open circuit or before the scan. Approximate reported times remained nominal estimates.
1 explicitly stirred or rotating electrode, 0 explicitly quiescent; missing otherwise. Stationary current and gas bubbling did not establish agitation state.
Nominal bromide amount from explicit NaBr molarity, one Br per NaBr. Normality was not converted.
Nominal sulfate amount from explicit Na2SO4 molarity in a recipe without a named acid. No free-ion speciation calculation or acid contribution was inferred.
